assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Input image is a character identity and style reference only. Generate a NEW transparent 2 by 2 sheet with EXACTLY FOUR walking animation frames of aria, preserving the referenced character, costume, signature weapon, chibi proportions and bold outlines. All face RIGHT, same side-view camera, same height and center, exactly equal square cells with 12% transparent padding. Must be a real alternating-leg walk cycle, not four variations of the same stride! Frame order reading left to right, top to bottom: (1) near leg extended FORWARD to the RIGHT, far leg extended BACK to LEFT, both feet on baseline; (2) near foot planted below hip, FAR knee lifts and passes toward right, feet close together; (3) far leg extended FORWARD to RIGHT, near leg extended BACK to LEFT, the complete OPPOSITE split of frame 1; (4) far foot planted below hip, NEAR knee lifts and passes toward right. Near leg visibly overlaps far leg in every frame. Distinct silhouettes: wide stride, narrow passing, opposite wide stride, opposite passing. Keep torso facing right in all frames; do NOT mirror the whole character between frames. Draw both boots clearly, knees bending and heels lifting. Walking not running or fencing shuffle. Constant ground baseline at 87% cell height, constant head height with only subtle natural bob. Weapon carried safely. No attacks, no labels, no lines, no floor, no shadows. Crisp 2-3 tone cel shading, details legible at 64px character height, authentic transparent alpha. Output square canvas.
